If it’s a software/API interface, please specify the platform or framework (e.g., a particular SDK, a web service, etc.) and what kind of details you’re after (parameters, return types, usage examples, etc.).  

Once I have that context, I can guide you on the exact commands, API calls, or even fetch the relevant JSON data using the `requests_get` tool.
